segments.evidence: Gujia, MM Future and HC Securities, which provide market data services and consulting services

segments.name: Introducing broker services
segments.description: Acts as an introducing broker, clearing all transactions through a clearing broker dealer and earning fees from customers.
segments.evidence: MM Global, which operates as an introducing broker that clears all transactions through a clearing broker dealer and earns commission income, placement agent services fee and other related income from customers

revenueModel.text: Customers pay MM Global for introducing broker commission income, placement agent services and other related income, while the market data and consulting entities charge clients for their services.
revenueModel.evidence: our fully owned subsidiary, MM Global, operates as a securities broker-dealer, generated Placement agent services revenue of $807,500 and $1,860,000, and other related revenue of nil and $8,333, for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively
